title: The Managed Database Died, So Boytasks Built Its Own | vitalii.no
description:
On 2026-08-21 the managed Supabase project behind Boytasks — a free-plan project with no backups — stopped accepting Postgres connections. A pause-and-restore brought it back just long enough to grab a full pg_dump before it could die for good. Two sibling projects, the portfolio and jobbot, had already left managed Supabase the exact same way.

The fix was a minimal self-hosted stack built directly on the Contabo VPS: a Postgres 17 database, a PostgREST layer for the REST API, GoTrue for auth with Google OAuth, and an nginx gateway standing in for Kong to handle the apikey check, routing, and CORS preflight. The URL moved to the new self-hosted address everywhere it was used — the app, both Cloudflare Workers, the routine prompt, and the scripts — but the JWT secret carried over unchanged, so every existing key kept working with zero rotation. A daily systemd timer now keeps 14 days of backups.

The whole stack adds about 120 megabytes on a VPS already running near 77 percent RAM, offset by a fresh 2 gigabyte swap file for headroom. Nothing in the application code had to change except the URL it talks to.
